links.outcome: Accuracy and safety of GPT-4o mini answers to dermatology patient questions versus specialists
links.effect: Some answers contained inaccuracies that could lead to risky patient management; authors suggest retrieval from reliable sources to improve safety and accuracy.
links.quote: While GPT-4o mini provided clearer and more updated information, some answers contained inaccuracies that could lead to risky patient management.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and safety of GPT-4o mini generated responses to dermatology questions compared to specialist answers, but does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard intervention.
